notes.title: BLAST!!!! Exploding Judo Federation at EVO 2025!
notes.notes: [p]THAT'S RIGHT! Exploding Judo Federation will be featured as a part of the indie fighting game developer expo as a part of [b]EVO Las Vegas[/b], from August 1 to August 3 -  with 3 new, unannounced playable characters![/p][p]Come with your friends and play it at the [b]Der Mondhase[/b] indie booth, chat with the developer and - why not? - challenge him to a duel![/p][p][b]Schwarzerblitz[/b] will also be there too, if you fancy checking that out! If you are around, come and say hi! (if you say "INABA sends her worst regards" too, I'll know you read this announcement)![/p][p][/p][p]Join the fight and [b]BLAST'EM TO THE GROUND![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658218/b6f29e3def677ae6488646d74e4a41935305c8e6.png"][/img][/p]
